http://purl.org/dc/terms/Location.definition: A spatial region or named place.
http://purl.org/dc/terms/Location.label: Location

properties.definition: Associates a spatial thing [ SDW-BP ] with a corresponding geometry.
properties.label: geometry
properties.usage_note: The range of this property ( locn:Geometry ) allows for any type of geometry specification. E.g., the geometry could be encoded by a literal, as WKT ( geosparql:wktLiteral [ GeoSPARQL ]), or represented by a class, as geosparql:Geometry (or any of its subclasses) [ GeoSPARQL ].

properties.definition: The geographic bounding box of a spatial thing [ SDW-BP ].
properties.label: bounding box
properties.usage_note: The range of this property ( rdfs:Literal ) is intentionally generic, with the purpose of allowing different geometry literal encodings. E.g., the geometry could be encoded as a WKT literal ( geosparql:wktLiteral [ GeoSPARQL ]).

properties.definition: The geographic center (centroid) of a spatial thing [ SDW-BP ].
properties.label: centroid
properties.usage_note: The range of this property ( rdfs:Literal ) is intentionally generic, with the purpose of allowing different geometry literal encodings. E.g., the geometry could be encoded as a WKT literal ( geosparql:wktLiteral [ GeoSPARQL ]).

http://purl.org/dc/terms/Location.usage_note: For an extensive geometry (i.e., a set of coordinates denoting the vertices of the relevant geographic area), the property locn:geometry [ LOCN ] SHOULD be used. For a geographic bounding box delimiting a spatial area the property dcat:bbox SHOULD be used. For the geographic center of a spatial area, or another characteristic point, the property dcat:centroid SHOULD be used.

http://purl.org/dc/terms/PeriodOfTime.definition: An interval of time that is named or defined by its start and end.
http://purl.org/dc/terms/PeriodOfTime.label: Period of Time

properties.definition: The start of the period.
properties.label: start date
properties.range_text: rdfs:Literal encoded using the relevant ISO 8601 Date and Time compliant string [ DATETIME ] and typed using the appropriate XML Schema datatype [ XMLSCHEMA11-2 ] ( xsd:gYear , xsd:gYearMonth , xsd:date , or xsd:dateTime ).

properties.definition: The end of the period.
properties.label: end date
properties.range_text: rdfs:Literal encoded using the relevant ISO 8601 Date and Time compliant string [ DATETIME ] and typed using the appropriate XML Schema datatype [ XMLSCHEMA11-2 ]

properties.definition: Beginning of a period or interval.
properties.label: beginning
properties.usage_note: Use of the property time:hasBeginning entails that value of the dcterms:temporal property is a member of the time:TemporalEntity class from [ OWL-TIME ]. In this context this could be taken to imply that dcterms:PeriodOfTime is equivalent to the sub-class time:ProperInterval

properties.definition: End of a period or interval.
properties.label: end
properties.usage_note: Use of the property time:hasEnd entails that value of the dcterms:temporal property is a member of the time:TemporalEntity class from [ OWL-TIME ]. In this context this could be taken to imply that dcterms:PeriodOfTime is equivalent to the sub-class time:ProperInterval

http://purl.org/dc/terms/PeriodOfTime.usage_note: The start and end of the interval SHOULD be given by using properties dcat:startDate or time:hasBeginning , and dcat:endDate or time:hasEnd , respectively. The interval can also be open - i.e., it can have just a start or just an end.

http://spdx.org/rdf/terms#Checksum.definition: A Checksum is a value that allows to check the integrity of the contents of a file. Even small changes to the content of the file will change its checksum. This class allows the results of a variety of checksum and cryptographic message digest algorithms to be represented [ SPDX ].
http://spdx.org/rdf/terms#Checksum.label: Checksum

properties.definition: Identifies the algorithm used to produce the subject Checksum [ SPDX ].
properties.label: algorithm
properties.range_text: The set of individuals of class spdx:ChecksumAlgorithm .
properties.usage_note: Version 2.2 of [ SPDX ] defines individuals for the following algorithms: MD2 , MD4 , MD5 , MD6 , SHA-1 , SHA-224 , SHA-256 , SHA-384 , SHA-512 .

properties.definition: The checksumValue property provides a lowercase hexadecimal encoded digest value produced using a specific algorithm [ SPDX ].
properties.label: checksum value

http://spdx.org/rdf/terms#Checksum.usage_note: The Checksum includes the algorithm ( spdx:algorithm ) and value ( spdx:checksumValue ) that allows the integrity of a file to be verified to ensure no errors occurred in transmission or storage.

http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#Conc.definition: A category or a theme used to describe datasets in the catalog.
http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#Conc.label: Concept
http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#Conc.usage_note: It is recommended to use either skos:inScheme or skos:topConceptOf on every skos:Concept used to classify datasets to link it to the concept scheme it belongs to. This concept scheme is typically associated with the catalog using dcat:themeTaxonomy .

http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#Conc.definition: A knowledge organization system (KOS) used to represent themes/categories of datasets in the catalog.
http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#Conc.label: Concept Scheme

http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#Catalog.definition: A curated collection of metadata about resources.
http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#Catalog.label: Catalog

properties.definition: A homepage of the catalog (a public Web document usually available in HTML).
properties.label: homepage
properties.usage_note: foaf:homepage is an inverse functional property (IFP) which means that it MUST be unique and precisely identify the Web-page for the resource. This property indicates the canonical Web-page, which might be helpful in cases where there is more than one Web-page about the resource.

properties.definition: A knowledge organization system (KOS) used to classify the resources documented in the catalog (e.g., datasets and services).
properties.label: themes
properties.usage_note: It is recommended that the taxonomy is organized in a skos:ConceptScheme , skos:Collection , owl:Ontology or similar, which allows each member to be denoted by an IRI and published as Linked Data.

properties.definition: A resource that is listed in the catalog.
properties.label: resource
properties.usage_note: This is the most general predicate for membership of a catalog. Use of a more specific sub-property is recommended when available.

properties.definition: A dataset that is listed in the catalog.
properties.label: dataset

properties.definition: A service that is listed in the catalog.
properties.label: service

properties.definition: A catalog that is listed in the catalog.
properties.label: catalog

properties.definition: A record describing the registration of a single resource (e.g., a dataset, a data service) that is part of the catalog.
properties.label: catalog record

http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#Catalog.usage_note: Datasets and data services are examples of resources in the context of a data catalog.

http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#CatalogRecord.definition: A record in a catalog, describing the registration of a single dcat:Resource .
http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#CatalogRecord.label: Catalog Record

properties.definition: A name given to the record.
properties.label: title

properties.definition: A free-text account of the record.
properties.label: description

properties.definition: The date of listing (i.e., formal recording) of the corresponding dataset or service in the catalog.
properties.label: listing date
properties.range_text: rdfs:Literal encoded using the relevant ISO 8601 Date and Time compliant string [ DATETIME ] and typed using the appropriate XML Schema datatype [ XMLSCHEMA11-2 ] ( xsd:gYear , xsd:gYearMonth , xsd:date , or xsd:dateTime ).
properties.usage_note: This indicates the date of listing the dataset in the catalog and not the publication date of the dataset itself.

properties.definition: Most recent date on which the catalog entry was changed, updated or modified.
properties.label: update/modification date
properties.range_text: rdfs:Literal encoded using the relevant ISO 8601 Date and Time compliant string [ DATETIME ] and typed using the appropriate XML Schema datatype [ XMLSCHEMA11-2 ] ( xsd:gYear , xsd:gYearMonth , xsd:date , or xsd:dateTime ).
properties.usage_note: This indicates the date of last change of a catalog entry, i.e., the catalog metadata description of the dataset, and not the date of the dataset itself.

properties.definition: The dcat:Resource (dataset or service) described in the record.
properties.label: primary topic
properties.usage_note: foaf:primaryTopic property is functional: each catalog record can have at most one primary topic, i.e., describes one cataloged resource.

properties.definition: An established standard to which the described resource conforms.
properties.label: conforms to
properties.range_text: dcterms:Standard (A basis for comparison; a reference point against which other things can be evaluated.)
properties.usage_note: This property SHOULD be used to indicate the model, schema, ontology, view or profile that the catalog record metadata conforms to.

http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#CatalogRecord.usage_note: This class is optional and not all catalogs will use it. It exists for catalogs where a distinction is made between metadata about a dataset or service and metadata about the entry in the catalog about the dataset or service . For example, the publication date property of the dataset reflects the date when the information was originally made available by the publishing agency, while the publication date of the catalog record is the date when the dataset was added to the catalog. In cases where both dates differ, or where only the latter is known, the publication date SHOULD only be specified for the catalog record. Notice that the W3C PROV Ontology [ PROV-O ] allows describing further provenance information such as the details of the process and the agent involved in a particular change to a dataset or its registration.

http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#DataService.definition: A collection of operations that provides access to one or more datasets or data processing functions.
http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#DataService.label: Data Service

properties.definition: The root location or primary endpoint of the service (a Web-resolvable IRI ).
properties.label: endpoint URL

properties.definition: A description of the services available via the end-points, including their operations, parameters etc.
properties.label: endpoint description
properties.usage_note: An endpoint description may be expressed in a machine-readable form, such as an OpenAPI (Swagger) description [ OpenAPI ], an OGC GetCapabilities response [ WFS ], [ ISO-19142 ], [ WMS ], [ ISO-19128 ], a SPARQL Service Description [ SPARQL11-SERVICE-DESCRIPTION ], an [ OpenSearch ] or [ WSDL20 ] document, a Hydra API description [ HYDRA ], else in text or some other informal mode if a formal representation is not possible.

properties.definition: A collection of data that this data service can distribute.
properties.label: serves dataset

http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#DataService.usage_note: The kind of service can be indicated using the dcterms:type property. Its value may be taken from a controlled vocabulary such as the INSPIRE spatial data service type code list [ INSPIRE-SDST ].

http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#Dataset.definition: A collection of data, published or curated by a single agent, and available for access or download in one or more representations.
http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#Dataset.label: Dataset

properties.definition: An available distribution of the dataset.
properties.label: distribution

properties.definition: The frequency at which a dataset is published.
properties.label: frequency
properties.range_text: dcterms:Frequency (A rate at which something recurs)
properties.usage_note: The value of dcterms:accrualPeriodicity gives the rate at which the dataset-as-a-whole is updated. This may be complemented by dcat:temporalResolution to give the time between collected data points in a time series.

properties.definition: A dataset series of which the dataset is part.
properties.label: in series

properties.definition: The geographical area covered by the dataset.
properties.label: spatial/geographical coverage
properties.range_text: dcterms:Location (A spatial region or named place)
properties.usage_note: The spatial coverage of a dataset may be encoded as an instance of dcterms:Location , or may be indicated using an IRI reference (link) to a resource describing a location. It is recommended that links are to entries in a well maintained gazetteer such as Geonames .

properties.definition: Minimum spatial separation resolvable in a dataset, measured in meters.
properties.label: spatial resolution
properties.usage_note: If the dataset is an image or grid this should correspond to the spacing of items. For other kinds of spatial datasets, this property will usually indicate the smallest distance between items in the dataset.

properties.definition: The temporal period that the dataset covers.
properties.label: temporal coverage
properties.range_text: dcterms:PeriodOfTime (An interval of time that is named or defined by its start and end dates)
properties.usage_note: The temporal coverage of a dataset may be encoded as an instance of dcterms:PeriodOfTime , or may be indicated using an IRI reference (link) to a resource describing a time period or interval.

properties.definition: Minimum time period resolvable in the dataset.
properties.label: temporal resolution
properties.usage_note: If the dataset is a time-series this should correspond to the spacing of items in the series. For other kinds of dataset, this property will usually indicate the smallest time difference between items in the dataset.

properties.definition: An activity that generated, or provides the business context for, the creation of the dataset.
properties.label: was generated by
properties.range_text: prov:Activity An activity is something that occurs over a period of time and acts upon or with entities; it may include consuming, processing, transforming, modifying, relocating, using, or generating entities.
properties.usage_note: Use prov:qualifiedGeneration to attach additional details about the relationship between the dataset and the activity, e.g., the exact time that the dataset was produced during the lifetime of a project

http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#Dataset.usage_note: The notion of dataset in DCAT is broad and inclusive, with the intention of accommodating resource types arising from all communities. Data comes in many forms including numbers, text, pixels, imagery, sound and other multi-media, and potentially other types, any of which might be collected into a dataset.

http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#DatasetSeries.definition: A collection of datasets that are published separately, but share some characteristics that group them.
http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#DatasetSeries.label: Dataset Series
http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#DatasetSeries.usage_note: Common scenarios for dataset series include: time series composed of periodically released subsets; map-series composed of items of the same type or theme but with differing spatial footprints.

http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#Distribution.definition: A specific representation of a dataset. A dataset might be available in multiple serializations that may differ in various ways, including natural language, media-type or format, schematic organization, temporal and spatial resolution, level of detail or profiles (which might specify any or all of the above).
http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#Distribution.label: Distribution

properties.definition: A name given to the distribution.
properties.label: title

properties.definition: A free-text account of the distribution.
properties.label: description

properties.definition: Date of formal issuance (e.g., publication) of the distribution.
properties.label: release date
properties.range_text: rdfs:Literal encoded using the relevant ISO 8601 Date and Time compliant string [ DATETIME ] and typed using the appropriate XML Schema datatype [ XMLSCHEMA11-2 ] ( xsd:gYear , xsd:gYearMonth , xsd:date , or xsd:dateTime ).
properties.usage_note: This property SHOULD be set using the first known date of issuance.

properties.definition: Most recent date on which the distribution was changed, updated or modified.
properties.label: update/modification date
properties.range_text: rdfs:Literal encoded using the relevant ISO 8601 Date and Time compliant string [ DATETIME ] and typed using the appropriate XML Schema datatype [ XMLSCHEMA11-2 ] ( xsd:gYear , xsd:gYearMonth , xsd:date , or xsd:dateTime ).

properties.definition: A legal document under which the distribution is made available.
properties.label: license
properties.usage_note: Information about licenses and rights SHOULD be provided on the level of Distribution. Information about licenses and rights MAY be provided for a Dataset in addition to but not instead of the information provided for the Distributions of that Dataset. Providing license or rights information for a Dataset that is different from information provided for a Distribution of that Dataset SHOULD be avoided as this can create legal conflicts. See also guidance at 9. License and rights statements .

properties.definition: A rights statement that concerns how the distribution is accessed.
properties.label: access rights
properties.usage_note: Information about licenses and rights MAY be provided for the Distribution. See also guidance at 9. License and rights statements .

properties.definition: Information about rights held in and over the distribution.
properties.label: rights
properties.usage_note: dcterms:license , which is a sub-property of dcterms:rights , can be used to link a distribution to a license document. However, dcterms:rights allows linking to a rights statement that can include licensing information as well as other information that supplements the license such as attribution. Information about licenses and rights SHOULD be provided on the level of Distribution. Information about licenses and rights MAY be provided for a Dataset in addition to but not instead of the information provided for the Distributions of that Dataset. Providing license or rights information for a Dataset that is different from information provided for a Distribution of that Dataset SHOULD be avoided as this can create legal conflicts. See also guidance at 9. License and rights statements .

properties.definition: An ODRL conformant policy expressing the rights associated with the distribution.
properties.label: has policy
properties.usage_note: Information about rights expressed as an ODRL policy [ ODRL-MODEL ] using the ODRL vocabulary [ ODRL-VOCAB ] MAY be provided for the distribution. See also guidance at 9. License and rights statements .

properties.definition: A URL of the resource that gives access to a distribution of the dataset. E.g., landing page, feed, SPARQL endpoint.
properties.label: access URL
properties.usage_note: dcat:accessURL SHOULD be used for the URL of a service or location that can provide access to this distribution, typically through a Web form, query or API call. dcat:downloadURL is preferred for direct links to downloadable resources. If the distribution(s) are accessible only through a landing page (i.e., direct download URLs are not known), then the landing page URL associated with the dcat:Dataset SHOULD be duplicated as access URL on a distribution (see 5.7 Dataset available only behind some Web page ).

properties.definition: A data service that gives access to the distribution of the dataset
properties.label: access service
properties.usage_note: dcat:accessService SHOULD be used to link to a description of a dcat:DataService that can provide access to this distribution.

properties.definition: The URL of the downloadable file in a given format. E.g., CSV file or RDF file. The format is indicated by the distribution's dcterms:format and/or dcat:mediaType
properties.label: download URL
properties.usage_note: dcat:downloadURL SHOULD be used for the URL at which this distribution is available directly, typically through a HTTP Get request.

properties.definition: The size of a distribution in bytes.
properties.label: byte size
properties.usage_note: While it is recommended that the size be given as an integer, alternative literals such as '1.5 MB' are sometimes used.

properties.definition: The minimum spatial separation resolvable in a dataset distribution, measured in meters.
properties.label: spatial resolution
properties.usage_note: Alternative spatial resolutions might be provided as different dataset distributions

properties.definition: Minimum time period resolvable in the dataset distribution.
properties.label: temporal resolution
properties.usage_note: Alternative temporal resolutions might be provided in different dataset distributions

properties.definition: An established standard to which the distribution conforms.
properties.label: conforms to
properties.range_text: dcterms:Standard (A basis for comparison; a reference point against which other things can be evaluated.)
properties.usage_note: This property SHOULD be used to indicate the model, schema, ontology, view or profile that this representation of a dataset conforms to. This is (generally) a complementary concern to the media-type or format.

properties.definition: The media type of the distribution as defined by IANA [ IANA-MEDIA-TYPES ].
properties.label: media type
properties.usage_note: This property SHOULD be used when the media type of the distribution is defined in IANA [ IANA-MEDIA-TYPES ], otherwise dcterms:format MAY be used with different values.

properties.definition: The file format of the distribution.
properties.label: format
properties.usage_note: dcat:mediaType SHOULD be used if the type of the distribution is defined by IANA [ IANA-MEDIA-TYPES ].

properties.definition: The compression format of the distribution in which the data is contained in a compressed form, e.g., to reduce the size of the downloadable file.
properties.label: compression format
properties.usage_note: This property to be used when the files in the distribution are compressed, e.g., in a ZIP file. The format SHOULD be expressed using a media type as defined by IANA [ IANA-MEDIA-TYPES ], if available.

properties.definition: The package format of the distribution in which one or more data files are grouped together, e.g., to enable a set of related files to be downloaded together.
properties.label: packaging format
properties.usage_note: This property to be used when the files in the distribution are packaged, e.g., in a TAR file , a ZIP file , a Frictionless Data Package or a Bagit file. The format SHOULD be expressed using a media type as defined by IANA [ IANA-MEDIA-TYPES ], if available.

properties.definition: The checksum property provides a mechanism that can be used to verify that the contents of a file or package have not changed [ SPDX ].
properties.label: checksum
properties.usage_note: The checksum is related to the download URL.

http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#Distribution.usage_note: This represents a general availability of a dataset. It implies no information about the actual access method of the data, i.e., whether by direct download, API , or through a Web page. The use of dcat:downloadURL property indicates directly downloadable distributions.

http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#Relationship.definition: An association class for attaching additional information to a relationship between DCAT Resources
http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#Relationship.label: Relationship

properties.definition: The resource related to the source resource.
properties.label: relation
properties.usage_note: In the context of a dcat:Relationship this is expected to point to another dcat:Dataset or other cataloged resource.

properties.definition: The function of an entity or agent with respect to another entity or resource.
properties.label: had role
properties.usage_note: May be used in a qualified-relation to specify the role of an Entity with respect to another Entity. It is recommended that the value be taken from a controlled vocabulary of entity roles.

http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#Relationship.usage_note: Use to characterize a relationship between datasets, and potentially other resources, where the nature of the relationship is known but is not adequately characterized by the standard [ DCTERMS ] properties ( dcterms:hasPart , dcterms:isPartOf , dcterms:conformsTo , dcterms:isFormatOf , dcterms:hasFormat , dcterms:isVersionOf , dcterms:hasVersion , dcterms:replaces , dcterms:isReplacedBy , dcterms:references , dcterms:isReferencedBy , dcterms:requires , dcterms:isRequiredBy ) or [ PROV-O ] properties ( prov:wasDerivedFrom , prov:wasInfluencedBy , prov:wasQuotedFrom , prov:wasRevisionOf , prov:hadPrimarySource , prov:alternateOf , prov:specializationOf )

http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#Resource.definition: Resource published or curated by a single agent.
http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#Resource.label: Cataloged Resource

properties.definition: Information about who can access the resource or an indication of its security status.
properties.label: access rights
properties.usage_note: Information about licenses and rights MAY be provided for the Resource. See also guidance at 9. License and rights statements .

properties.definition: An established standard to which the described resource conforms.
properties.label: conforms to
properties.range_text: dcterms:Standard ("A basis for comparison; a reference point against which other things can be evaluated." [ DCTERMS ])
properties.usage_note: This property SHOULD be used to indicate the model, schema, ontology, view or profile that the cataloged resource content conforms to.

properties.definition: Relevant contact information for the cataloged resource. Use of vCard is recommended [ VCARD-RDF ].
properties.label: contact point

properties.definition: The entity responsible for producing the resource.
properties.label: creator
properties.usage_note: Resources of type foaf:Agent are recommended as values for this property.

properties.definition: A free-text account of the resource.
properties.label: description

properties.definition: A name given to the resource.
properties.label: title

properties.definition: Date of formal issuance (e.g., publication) of the resource.
properties.label: release date
properties.range_text: rdfs:Literal encoded using the relevant ISO 8601 Date and Time compliant string [ DATETIME ] and typed using the appropriate XML Schema datatype [ XMLSCHEMA11-2 ] ( xsd:gYear , xsd:gYearMonth , xsd:date , or xsd:dateTime ).
properties.usage_note: This property SHOULD be set using the first known date of issuance.

properties.definition: Most recent date on which the resource was changed, updated or modified.
properties.label: update/modification date
properties.range_text: rdfs:Literal encoded using the relevant ISO 8601 Date and Time compliant string [ DATETIME ] and typed using the appropriate XML Schema datatype [ XMLSCHEMA11-2 ] ( xsd:gYear , xsd:gYearMonth , xsd:date , or xsd:dateTime ).
properties.usage_note: The value of this property indicates a change to the actual resource, not a change to the catalog record. An absent value MAY indicate that the resource has never changed after its initial publication, or that the date of last modification is not known, or that the resource is continuously updated.

properties.definition: A language of the resource. This refers to the natural language used for textual metadata (i.e., titles, descriptions, etc.) of a cataloged resource (i.e., dataset or service) or the textual values of a dataset distribution
properties.label: language
properties.range_text: dcterms:LinguisticSystem Resources defined by the Library of Congress ( ISO 639-1 , ISO 639-2 ) SHOULD be used. If a ISO 639-1 (two-letter) code is defined for language, then its corresponding IRI SHOULD be used; if no ISO 639-1 code is defined, then IRI corresponding to the ISO 639-2 (three-letter) code SHOULD be used.
properties.usage_note: If representations of a dataset are available for each language separately, define an instance of dcat:Distribution for each language and describe the specific language of each distribution using dcterms:language (i.e., the dataset will have multiple dcterms:language values and each distribution will have just one as the value of its dcterms:language property). In case of multilingual distributions, the distributions will have multiple dcterms:language values.

properties.definition: The entity responsible for making the resource available.
properties.label: publisher
properties.usage_note: Resources of type foaf:Agent are recommended as values for this property.

properties.definition: A unique identifier of the resource being described or cataloged.
properties.label: identifier
properties.usage_note: The identifier is a text string which is assigned to the resource to provide an unambiguous reference within a particular context.

properties.definition: A main category of the resource. A resource can have multiple themes.
properties.label: theme/category
properties.usage_note: The set of themes used to categorize the resources are organized in a skos:ConceptScheme , skos:Collection , owl:Ontology or similar, describing all the categories and their relations in the catalog.

properties.definition: The nature or genre of the resource.
properties.label: type/genre
properties.usage_note: To describe the file format, physical medium, or dimensions of the resource, use the dcterms:format element.

properties.definition: A resource with an unspecified relationship to the cataloged resource.
properties.label: relation
properties.usage_note: dcterms:relation SHOULD be used where the nature of the relationship between a cataloged resource and related resources is not known. A more specific sub-property SHOULD be used if the nature of the relationship of the link is known. The property dcat:distribution SHOULD be used to link from a dcat:Dataset to a representation of the dataset, described as a dcat:Distribution

properties.definition: Link to a description of a relationship with another resource
properties.label: qualified relation
properties.usage_note: Used to link to another resource where the nature of the relationship is known but does not match one of the standard [ DCTERMS ] properties ( dcterms:hasPart , dcterms:isPartOf , dcterms:conformsTo , dcterms:isFormatOf , dcterms:hasFormat , dcterms:isVersionOf , dcterms:hasVersion , dcterms:replaces , dcterms:isReplacedBy , dcterms:references , dcterms:isReferencedBy , dcterms:requires , dcterms:isRequiredBy ) or [ PROV-O ] properties ( prov:wasDerivedFrom , prov:wasInfluencedBy , prov:wasQuotedFrom , prov:wasRevisionOf , prov:hadPrimarySource , prov:alternateOf , prov:specializationOf ).

properties.definition: A keyword or tag describing the resource.
properties.label: keyword/tag

properties.definition: A Web page that can be navigated to in a Web browser to gain access to the catalog, a dataset, its distributions and/or additional information.
properties.label: landing page
properties.usage_note: If the distribution(s) are accessible only through a landing page (i.e., direct download URLs are not known), then the landing page link SHOULD be duplicated as dcat:accessURL on a distribution. (see 5.7 Dataset available only behind some Web page )

properties.definition: Link to an Agent having some form of responsibility for the resource
properties.label: qualified attribution
properties.usage_note: Used to link to an Agent where the nature of the relationship is known but does not match one of the standard [ DCTERMS ] properties ( dcterms:creator , dcterms:publisher ). Use dcat:hadRole on the prov:Attribution to capture the responsibility of the Agent with respect to the Resource. See 15.1 Relationships between datasets and agents for usage examples.

properties.definition: A legal document under which the resource is made available.
properties.label: license
properties.usage_note: Information about licenses and rights MAY be provided for the Resource. See also guidance at 9. License and rights statements .

properties.definition: A statement that concerns all rights not addressed with dcterms:license or dcterms:accessRights , such as copyright statements.
properties.label: rights
properties.usage_note: Information about licenses and rights MAY be provided for the Resource. See also guidance at 9. License and rights statements .

properties.definition: A related resource that is included either physically or logically in the described resource.
properties.label: has part

properties.definition: An ODRL conformant policy expressing the rights associated with the resource.
properties.label: has policy
properties.usage_note: Information about rights expressed as an ODRL policy [ ODRL-MODEL ] using the ODRL vocabulary [ ODRL-VOCAB ] MAY be provided for the resource. See also guidance at 9. License and rights statements .

properties.definition: A related resource, such as a publication, that references, cites, or otherwise points to the cataloged resource.
properties.label: is referenced by
properties.usage_note: This property is used to associate a resource with the resource (of type dcat:Resource ) in question. For other relations to resources not covered with this property, the more generic property dcat:qualifiedRelation can be used. See also 15. Qualified relations .

properties.definition: The previous version of a resource in a lineage [ PAV ].
properties.label: previous version
properties.usage_note: This property is meant to be used to specify a version chain, consisting of snapshots of a resource. The notion of version used by this property is limited to versions resulting from revisions occurring to a resource as part of its life-cycle. One of the typical cases here is representing the history of the versions of a dataset that have been released over time.

properties.definition: This resource has a more specific, versioned resource [ PAV ].
properties.label: has version
properties.usage_note: This property is intended for relating a non-versioned or abstract resource to several versioned resources, e.g., snapshots [ PAV ]. The notion of version used by this property is limited to versions resulting from revisions occurring to a resource as part of its life-cycle. Therefore, its semantics is more specific than its super-property dcterms:hasVersion , which makes use of a broader notion of version, including editions and adaptations.

properties.definition: This resource has a more specific, versioned resource with equivalent content [ PAV ].
properties.label: current version
properties.usage_note: This property is intended for relating a non-versioned or abstract resource to a single snapshot that can be used as a permalink to indicate the current version of the content [ PAV ]. The notion of version used by this property is limited to versions resulting from revisions occurring to a resource as part of its life-cycle.

properties.definition: A related resource that is supplanted, displaced, or superseded by the described resource [ DCTERMS ].
properties.label: replaces

properties.definition: The version indicator (name or identifier) of a resource.
properties.label: version
properties.usage_note: DCAT does not prescribe how a version name / identifier should be specified, and refers for guidance to [ DWBP ]'s Best Practice 7: Provide a version indicator .

properties.definition: A description of changes between this version and the previous version of the resource [ VOCAB-ADMS ].
properties.label: version notes
properties.usage_note: In case of backward compatibility issues with the previous version of the resource, a textual description of them SHOULD be specified by using this property.

properties.definition: The status of the resource in the context of a particular workflow process [ VOCAB-ADMS ].
properties.label: status
properties.usage_note: DCAT does not prescribe the use of any specific set of life-cycle statuses, but refers to existing standards and community practices fit for the relevant application scenario.

properties.definition: The first resource in an ordered collection or series of resources, to which the current resource belongs.
properties.label: first
properties.usage_note: In DCAT this property is used for resources belonging to a dcat:DatasetSeries .

properties.definition: The last resource in an ordered collection or series of resources, to which the current resource belongs.
properties.label: last
properties.usage_note: In DCAT this property is used for resources belonging to a dcat:DatasetSeries .

properties.definition: The previous resource (before the current one) in an ordered collection or series of resources.
properties.label: previous
properties.usage_note: In DCAT this property is used for resources belonging to a dcat:DatasetSeries . It is important to note that this property is different from dcat:previousVersion , as it does not denote a previous version of the same resource, but a distinct resource immediately preceding the current one in an ordered collection of resources.

http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#Resource.usage_note: dcat:Resource is an extension point that enables the definition of any kind of catalog. Additional sub-classes may be defined in a DCAT profile or other DCAT application for catalogs of other kinds of resources.

http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#Role.definition: A role is the function of a resource or agent with respect to another resource, in the context of resource attribution or resource relationships.
http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#Role.label: Role
http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#Role.usage_note: Used in a qualified-relation to specify the role of an Entity with respect to another Entity. It is recommended that the values be managed as a controlled vocabulary of entity roles such as [ ISO-19115-1 ] DS_AssociationTypeCode IANA Registry of Link Relations [ IANA-RELATIONS ] DataCite metadata schema [ DataCite ] MARC relators
